author: PC Gamer
text:
Compulsion Games' buyout is complete, so now Microsoft won't get a cut if you buy South of Midnight
An Xbox Game Studio no more.

author: PC Gamer
text:
GTA6 leaker Cyberleek shows off gas station rampage, refueling, promises strip club gameplay if people juice his cryptocurrency enough
Ok.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Fallout dev Tim Cain says we should pay more attention to bad games: '[Publishers] often don't learn from failure because they only look at the games that sold well'
"Gamers will frequently point to popular games and say, 'we want more of that,' without necessarily knowing exactly what part of those games made them so good."

author: PC Gamer
text:
The first physical PC game I remember playing shows what Sony is thoughtlessly destroying
Me and a bunch of big-box PC games are going to go full boomer or prove a very important point.

author: PC Gamer
text:
2XKO's shutdown has me feeling glum about Riot's future MMO—because I don't think the genre can survive corporate cut-and-run tactics
2XKO was losing money, but that doesn't mean it wasn't worth it.

author: PC Gamer
text:
This mod transforms Doom into a terrifying tactical shooter, and it's partly inspired by another PC gaming classic
Blackout makes Doom slower, deadlier, and throws in a Crysis-style energy suit for good measure.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Dishonored was a last-ditch effort by Arkane Studios after years of fruitless contract work, according to the game's co-creator: 'I think we had four months of money left'
"We were farming out people left and right."

author: PC Gamer
text:
The latest cooperative craze is a physics-based fishing simulator where you can launch your catch into the air and no-scope it with a sniper rifle
How to Fish sounds ridiculous.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Still more GTA 6 details from the latest leaked video: traffic cameras, car trackers, and drivers that put up a fight
With each leaked video we learn a bit more about the game.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Rockstar employees frustrated by GTA 6 leaks, though they may have only whet appetites for the reveal
The increased security measures following the 2022 hack didn't stop another major leak of GTA 6 gameplay.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The GTA 6 leaker is selling ads now
For $165,000, you too can ask Cyberleek about promoting your product on his videos.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Robot Olympics runner bravely sprints headfirst into wall and collapses in shower of sparks, is not a metaphor
This is not an event imbued with meaning.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The newly independent Psychonauts dev now earns all the revenue when you buy games it made under Xbox: 'Buying any of our games helps support the studio'
It also has a new Kickstarter campaign set to kickoff later this month.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Arc Raiders is halting Expeditions until 2027 so it can make 'major improvements' to the system
The fifth Expedition in September will be the last for a while.

author: PC Gamer
text:
2 Steam top sellers, 2 simultaneous betas, 2 very different shooters: It's Wardogs & Modern Warfare weekend
Which one are you checking out this weekend?

author: PC Gamer
text:
Don't tell Nintendo, but I turned GTA 5 into Pokémon Go using a mod
Also, probably don't tell Rockstar.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Lone game dev builds an explorable cyberpunk city almost entirely out of ASCII characters
Dot dot dot matrix.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Take-Two kicks off GTA 6 leaker hunt with subpoenas demanding records from Microsoft and Discord
Meanwhile, another new Grand Theft Auto 6 leak dropped today.
